name: Nine-Year Ember (Cửu Niên Tẫn)
lore: A bronze censer the size of two fists, holding one coal from the Red Furnace. Đồng Hồng Lô took the coal from the furnace mouth in 930, the winter his master died, and carried it on his belt through the nine years he kept the furnace lit (A028). He has never let it go out. He says so often. The vent warden Phòng Tẫn Thủ knows it went out once, in 1144.
build_use: The head's Burn engine: longer Burn on the foe, linh lực to keep feeding it, and a shield against the Water that could put it out.

name: Snow-Melt Gourd (Tuyết Thủy Hồ)
lore: A gourd of black spirit calabash, banded in copper, that fills itself with snow-melt overnight. Tần Tuyết Thán carved it in 1145 from a gourd the whale crews had carried since Kình Cốt Đường, and has poured from it into the furnace jackets every morning since.
build_use: Sustain for a Fire-Water alchemist who stands too close to her own fire.
exception: world-depth signature item: its base's common art or ward until an authored one is ruled (review R6)

name: Whale Road Spear (Kình Lộ Mâu)
lore: A harpoon of spirit-whale rib with an iron head and a line of sea-silk. It belonged to Nghiêu Phá Lãng's second, who brought the crews to Hồng Lô after 884 (V013). It has been the boat captain's since. Nghiêu Vọng Kình has had the head reforged twice and the rib never.
build_use: Holds a foe in place for the Whale Road Harpoon's line: accuracy and long Water debuffs.
exception: world-depth signature item: its base's common art or ward until an authored one is ruled (review R6)

name: Coal-Carrier's Ring (Đảm Thán Giới)
lore: A blackened iron ring the founder Tiết Thừa Hỏa put on the coal boy's finger in 772, the night he sat by her furnace until dawn and she took him as her disciple.
build_use: Heavier Burn and the fire's own guard.

name: The First Snow Jacket (Sơ Tuyết Giáp)
lore: The first of the snow jackets the furnace hall now wears, quilted with snow-melt water between two layers of silk; she made it for herself in 1150.
build_use: Healing taken and status resistance beside the furnace.

name: Steam Censer (Chưng Khí Lô)
lore: A small censer with a water jacket, in which she brews over her own Burn; the steam is the Primer's whole teaching.
build_use: Steam arts from Burn, and heals.
